meta.name: download-encode
meta.description: Download ENCODE genomics files (BED, FASTQ, BAM, bigWig, etc.) to the user's machine. Use when the user wants to download data files from ENCODE experiments.

copy.tagline: 下载ENCODE基因组数据文件到本地
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从ENCODE下载BED、FASTQ等基因组文件
copy.tagline_en: Download ENCODE genomics files to your machine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to download BED, FASTQ, or other genomics files from ENCODE

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索、预览并下载 ENCODE 数据库中的基因组文件（如 BED、bigWig、BAM、FASTQ），自动校验 MD5 完整性，并按实验或格式整理到本地文件夹。
howto.when: 当用户要求下载、获取或抓取 ENCODE 数据文件，或需要特定格式（如 BED、FASTQ）的基因组文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我下载 ENCODE 实验 ENCSR831JOY 的 IDR 峰值文件。
say.note: Claude 会列出文件并询问下载目录，然后下载并校验。

say.text: 批量下载所有 H3K4me3 组织样本的 bigWig 信号文件。
say.note: Claude 会先预览文件数量和大小，确认后开始下载。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search, preview, and download ENCODE genomics files (BED, bigWig, BAM, FASTQ, etc.) to the user's machine, with automatic MD5 verification and organization by experiment or format.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to download, get, or fetch ENCODE data files, or requests specific file formats like BED or FASTQ.

say_en.text: Download the IDR thresholded peaks for ENCODE experiment ENCSR831JOY.
say_en.note: Claude will list files, ask for a download directory, then download and verify.

say_en.text: Batch download all bigWig signal tracks for H3K4me3 across tissues.
say_en.note: Claude will preview file count and size, then proceed after confirmation.
